name: Wall of Fire (Thaumaturgy (Lure of Flames), Intermediate)

system.description: You conjure a six-foot column of unnatural flame at any location within fifty feet, inflicting aggravated damage to anyone struck when created and to anyone passing through it afterward, lasting until you extinguish it or move out of range.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until extinguished or out of range
